summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning algorithms from research to production. Developed U-Net medical image segmentation on MRI data (BraTS 2020) with VGG/ResNet backbones, ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for 3D surface reconstruction, and real-time object tracking pipelines on edge hardware. Skilled in PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and C++ across medical imaging, perception, and edge AI applications.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation models with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving PSNR of 86 vs. 65 for homography-based baseline.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom object detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained, evaluated, and deployed model improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5% in a consumer mobile application.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset using PyTorch.
Built standardized preprocessing and training pipelines; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved augmentation and model tuning.

projects.name: Real-Time Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object detection and tracking; transmitted control commands to STM32 over UART at deterministic intervals.

projects.name: Vision-Guided Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built TensorRT-accelerated YOLO visual servoing pipeline running at ~18 FPS on Jetson for pick-and-place guidance; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency across a distributed edge pipeline (Flutter client → Flask-SocketIO server → Jetson+Arduino).

projects.name: Autonomous Driving Perception in CARLA
bullets: Built automated CV data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 lane-detection training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 ~0.85) and ResNet-18-based UFLD; validated zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps in Town02.
